This PR fills documentation gaps identified by Mintlify Bot PRs #179 and #184.

## Highlights

- Added documentation for deleting request variables and reorganized request variable guidance.
- Expanded mock server documentation with collection/API spec sync, standalone mocks, port validation, and API spec validation.
- Documented inline variable creation, including request, collection, environment, global, and secret scopes.
- Added environment import/export improvements, including multi-file imports and drag-and-drop instructions.
- Updated navigation and redirects for request variables and request history.
- Added gRPC metadata and automation limitations.
- Expanded guidance for secret variables, sensitive field warnings, NTLM redirects, and unresolved variables.
- Documented CLI response-body printing, WSDL external schema references, prettify shortcuts, inherited folder tags, and related scripting behavior.
